title: An AI Made a 3D Shooter in One File
concept: Build-log/code-lab: terminal shock, file-size reveal, no-assets teardown, code-generates-everything diagram, cost/payoff.
cta: Follow AI Tested for AI builds that bend reality.

beats.narration: An AI made a playable 3D shooter in one file.
beats.headline: ONE FILE

beats.narration: No game studio. No artists. No sound team.
beats.headline: NO STUDIO

beats.narration: An Anthropic engineer ran Claude Fable 5.2 with no human feedback during the build.
beats.headline: CLAUDE FABLE 5.2

beats.narration: Eight hours later: Saltline, a browser FPS in a rainy harbor.
beats.headline: SALTLINE

beats.narration: No images. No audio files. No 3D models.
beats.headline: NO ASSETS
beats.sub: NO IMAGES · NO AUDIO · NO 3D MODELS

beats.narration: Code generates the geometry, textures, and sound.
beats.headline: CODE BUILT IT

beats.narration: Reported cost: around five hundred fifty dollars in API compute.
Not AAA. But it’s a scary preview of what one AI can build.
beats.headline: WHAT'S NEXT?
beats.sub: NOT AAA — BUT A REAL PREVIEW
